messages:
inc-bot: INCIDENT CREATED — P0: multi-region routing failures affecting inference requests. Detected by health checks and increased 5xx to hosted API. Autopage oncall.
oncall-alice: paging now. seeing spike in 5xx and a ton of requests falling back to model-variant 'mantic-3-medium' in eu-west despite region=us-east preference. initial hypothesis: smart-routing fallback loop + stale DNS endpoints. tagging SRE.
ben (sre): joining. can you paste the offending smart-routing policy or a sample route? any recent deploys to routing-controller in last 30m?
carol (eng-runtime): recent rollout to routing-controller 1833452400 included a change to fallbackPolicy precedence. I reverted a small bit but not the whole rollout. logs show: `route_decision: prefer-region(us-east) -> no endpoints -> fallback:model_variant('mantic-3-medium') -> endpoint(eu-west-edge-02)`
dan (netops): DNS side — we're seeing old geo RRset for *edge.redwood.ai* in some resolvers. auth zone has correct records, but several POP caches still serving a 304 TTL tied to a prior deployment. dig from different regions:
```
;; ANSWER SECTION:
edge.redwood.ai.  3600 IN A  54.12.34.56  # eu-west-02
edge.redwood.ai.  30   IN A  3.120.2.1    # us-east-01 (stale)
```
carol (eng-runtime): that mismatch explains why routing sees endpoints in eu-west but client region claims us-east and the controller's region check fails to match -> fallback triggers -> ends up hitting eu-west variant which then triggers retries and TTL-induced oscillation.
oncall-alice: customer impact: some customers in NA see increased latency and model mismatch (wrong weights). frank (cs): we already have 6 customers reporting inference outputs that don't match their pinned model. severity P0. pushing notice to org: @here P0 active, working on mitigation.
ben (sre): immediate mitigations: 1) pause smart-routing policy defaults to force region-affinity for active requests 2) add temporary static route for high-volume customer IPs -> us-east endpoints 3) flush edge DNS caches in critical PoPs if possible.
gina (infra): flushing caches: we can purge CDN caches and our internal resolver caches, but we need to coordinate with cloud provider for their public resolvers. opening ticket with cloud-dns ops now.
carol (eng-runtime): pause command:
```
# admin-shell
redwoodctl routing set-policy --name default --smart-routing=false --force
```
oncall-alice: executing pause now.
inc-bot: ALERT — routing policy change by oncall-alice at 1833456142
oncall-alice: policy paused. routing-controller reported: `policy_state: manual_override`.
ben (sre): started a canary static mapping for 3 high-volume customers: `map customer-ip x.x.x.x -> us-east-01` — added to service mesh rules. monitoring for 5xx rate drop.
frank (cs): notifying impacted customers: "we're aware, mitigation in progress, will follow up with timeline and postmortem". sent to enterprise slack channels and support tickets.
dan (netops): provider ticket opened: ticket-id CLD-908234. provider acknowledging partial propagation delay at their edge resolvers. they recommend lowering TTL to 30s then forcing a zone publish.
gina (infra): lowered TTL on authoritative zone to 30s and triggered zone publish. note: may take a couple minutes for provider caches.
carol (eng-runtime): observed immediate drop in cross-region misroutes after pause and static routes. 5xx reduced by ~70% from JA monitoring.
oncall-alice: good. next steps: keep manual override for 30m while we observe, then gradually re-enable smart-routing with tightened fallback policy.
ben (sre): post-mitigation: need to rollout fixed routing-controller (revert precedence change) and add guard: `if endpoint_region != request_region && endpoint_last_seen > 120s then ignore` — propose default of 120s to avoid stale endpoints.
carol (eng-runtime): adding that guard to PR now. will mark for patch rollout with canary to 10%.
eve (product): customer-facing note to cloud customers: short explainers for why model variant mismatch can happen and steps we took. will draft.
frank (cs): only one customer reported persistent mismatch after mitigations — collecting logs. pointing them to `us-east-01` test endpoint for verification.
dan (netops): provider reports purge completed for 12 of 13 edge PoPs; last one in APAC still serving old RRset, provider expects clearance in ~8 mins.
oncall-alice: handing off to ben for long-tail monitoring. I'm going offline for the 20:00 oncall handoff in 10m.
ben (sre): taking over. will keep the override until >30m stable and DNS caches show uniform records. opening incident timeline doc: `inc/1833456000` and assigning followups: DNS-propagation, routing-controller-fix, postmortem.
gina (infra): created infra ticket INF-183345-1 for DNS TTL/monitoring improvements and resolver health checks.
carol (eng-runtime): PR link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/routing/pulls/312 — includes revert + region-staleness-guard. scheduled canary at 1833457800.
oncall-alice: thanks team. summary for postmortem: root cause = TTL+provider propagation + routing-controller precedence change produced fallback loop and wrong model-variant routing; mitigations = policy pause, static mapping, TTL reset/publish, cache purge; next actions = revert, guard, probe for provider resolver behavior, add alert for endpoint-region-mismatch rate.
frank (cs): posting customer update draft in #support-drafts.
eve (product): will coordinate customer comms and compliance notify for enterprise contracts.
ben (sre): I'll keep monitoring, will update thread with 30m, and handoff to next oncall if stable. tagging followups: @carol @dan @gina for post-incident tasks.
inc-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED — status: mitigated -> monitoring. severity changes to P1 at 1833456550.
ben (sre): 30m check-in: metrics stable, no new reports, DNS propagation complete per provider. proceeding to enable smart-routing with stricter fallback flags in 5m canary.
carol (eng-runtime): enabling canary now (10%): `redwoodctl routing enable-smart --canary=10 --guard=endpoint_region_stale_seconds:120`.
inc-bot: CANARY OK — no regressions in 10% traffic after 10m. continuing rollout.
ben (sre): rolling to 100% over next 10m.
inc-bot: ROLL COMPLETE — policy back to automatic with new guard at 1833456789.
oncall-alice: handing off final to ben. leaving notes in incident doc and calendar handover.
ben (sre): acknowledged. I'll prepare the postmortem draft and notify stakeholders.
carol (eng-runtime): adding unit tests for region-staleness logic and a canary metric to catch model-variant flips.
frank (cs): closing customer tickets as mitigated; will followup with customers who reported outputs mismatch.
ben (sre): thanks everyone. closing thread when postmortem draft is ready. :thumbsup:
